name: Knight of Xoroth class trainer re-sends its window after a rank purchase so held Skulltaker ranks stay used (#10825)
contract: The Knight of Xoroth class trainer (trainer 900017, Spi'ro 50278) lists Skulltaker rank 1 800168 (level 1),
rank 2 802416 (level 8, requires 800168), rank 3 802417 (level 16, requires 802416) and rank 4 802418
(level 24, requires 802417). Learning a rank supersedes the one below it, so the client spellbook no longer
holds the lower rank. On the next spell learned the 3.3.5 client redraws trainer rows from its own spellbook
and offers the superseded rank again, which the server refuses as known (#10825). A level-24 knight holding
ranks 1 and 2 buys rank 3: the purchase must re-send the window, with ranks 2 and 3 known (2) and rank 4
available (0). Client rendering itself is outside this harness; the re-sent window replaces the redraw.

steps.label: fixture: enough copper for the lesson
right-click the Knight of Xoroth trainer
superseded rank 2 stays a used row
the bought rank is a used row
superseded rank 2 was never offered for purchase
